newsitem.title: FINLAND: KY CONFIRMS MOYNE'S LINK TO DUTCH AMER BUY.
newsitem.headline: KY CONFIRMS MOYNE'S LINK TO DUTCH AMER BUY.

text.p: Student organisation KY said in a statement late on Friday that British investor Jonathan Bryan Guinness, the third Lord Moyne, had transferred his right to buy KY's 275,000 Amer K shares to Dutch company Dirk Hus Beheer BV.
KY -- The Student Union of the Helsinki School of Economics and Business Administration -- said earlier it planned to sell the shares to the Dutch company for 75 million markka.

"Lord Moyne has transferred his rights as provided by the original offer from (KY) to a company by the name of Dirk Hus Beheer BV from the Netherlands," KY said in a statement, confirming Lord Moyne's link to the Dutch company.
The 275,000 shares give a 12.5 percent stake of votes and 1.2 percent of shares in Amer.
According to Amer's bylaws, the company and the other three owners of vote-strong but unlisted K shares have a right to redeem the shares.
Guinness had initially agreed to buy a clear majority of votes in Amer but the deal fell through when the other three K shareholders pulled out.
